about: Triage of batch n6 (Nibbāna, Emulate round 4), after the fresh reader of REVIEW.md (which read the first version of items 1 and 4, REVIEW-PROMPT.txt).

items.review: CHANGED: cc's "established based on perception of something" lost "when one thing perceives another" (the duality the paragraph contrasts), and its passive "This is distinguished" lost the texts as the ones drawing the distinction
items.decision: sample ca instead: "It is in contrast to the usual type of viññāṇaṃ (“sense consciousness”) that is established when one thing perceives another." It keeps his words for the duality; the contrast is still part of what the texts (DN 11, MN 49) describe in the sentence before. Its garbled diacritics fixed.

items.review: CHANGED (mild): lost his own reading ("shapes how I understand"), "naturally" and "absorbed"; "it relates in that" vague
items.decision: in, with "that analogy shapes how I understand it:" for "it relates in that" and "stay absorbed in a movie" for "stay in a movie"; "naturally" not put back (the "once" carries the consequence)
his words stay: every sample lost "the famous stanza I loved", the certainty of "I found out", or who said it

items.key: his "So enlightenment isn’t a simple bliss switch."
